title: isIncentiveCompatible_iff_equilibriumPayoff_ge
body_html:
isIncentiveCompatible_iff_equilibriumPayoff_ge

Lean type

lean theorem isIncentiveCompatible_iff_equilibriumPayoff_ge (A : BayesianSingleItemAuction I) : A.IsIncentiveCompatible ↔ ∀ (i : I) (v_i x_i : ℝ), A.equilibriumPayoff i v_i ≥ A.equilibriumPayoff i x_i + A.interimAllocProb i x_i * (v_i - x_i)

Dependencies

  • IsRegularMyersonOptimalICIRAuction.isIncentiveCompatible
  • IsIncentiveCompatible
  • interimQuasiLinearUtility_eq_equilibriumPayoff_add
